import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query to find distinct educational institutions within 5000m of any roadside station
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as count
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM air_quality_station aqs
    WHERE aqs.id IN (14, 16, 17)
    AND ST_DWithin(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography,
        5000
    )
)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
